parsed.modern: The oil of rue has a very acrid taste, and a penetrating smell, resembling that of the herb, but rather more unpleasant. It is sometimes made use of in hysteric disorders, and as an anthelmintic; as also in epilepsics proceeding from a relaxed state of the nerves.
